title: Effect of Rollback Prompt Interventions on Misalignment Elicitation Rate in Petri Audits

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Calibrating how Petri audit results should be interpreted is essential. If rollback inflates elicitation rates, Petri results may overstate real-world risk. Direct implication for audit methodology validity.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Petri is open source and accessible on single GPU. Running two conditions (with/without rollback) is conceptually simple. However, classifying whether outputs constitute autonomous deception requires judgment. 20 seeds is tractable.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Two conditions, 20 seed instructions, one model. Binary comparison of elicitation rates. Clean A/B design. Fits 30 hours with the 20-seed scope.
